webSearch.title: Gushakisha kuri Internet
webSearch.description: Igenzura uburyo ubushakisha kuri internet bukora iyo Search Mode ikoreshejwe. Impinduka zikoreshwa ako kanya.
webSearch.providerAutoDescription: Ikoresha defaults ya deployment — ubu gikoresha combined news search iri hasi.
webSearch.providerNewsDescription: Yohereza ibisabwa ku masoko yombi icyarimwe, igashyira hamwe ibisubizo; iyo isoko imwe itakoze, ubushakisha ntibuhagarara. Bitanga umuvuduko, itandukaniro ry’amasoko n’ihuriro rya links ryiza.
webSearch.providerGoogleNewsDescription: Byihuse kandi nta makuru y’imenyekana — gusa ikibazo cyo gushakisha kigerera kuri Google (nta konti cyangwa cookies) kandi ibisubizo biboneka mu kanya gato. Icyitonderwa: ahanini bigenzura vingingo n'agace gato, ntibisome inkingi yose, niyo mpamvu ibisubizo bishobora kuguma hejuru.
webSearch.providerGdeltDescription: Ububiko rusange bushakisha amakuru yo ku isi hamwe na links zijya ku banyamakuru, byemerera ibibazo bikurikira gusoma inkuru yose. Hariho umupaka ukomeye — gushakisha gukurikirana gushobora gutegereza amasegonda make.
webSearch.providerBingDescription: Isoma impapuro zose kugira ngo itange incamake irambuye kandi igasakara kuri internet hose, si ku makuru gusa. Ariko, gushakisha bimara amasegonda 30–90, kandi ubuziranenge bw’ibisubizo buratandukanye.
webSearch.sourcesDescription: Ni amasoko angahe atandukanye ubushakisha buzagaragaza nk’ahakomotse amakuru. Ibibazo byo mu bushakashatsi bishobora kongera aya masoko byikora.
webSearch.freshnessDescription: Ni igihe ikihe ibisubizo bikwiye kuba bishya. Automatic ibireka buri kibazo kigahitamo (amakuru mashya aha agaciro umunsi uheruka).
webSearch.providerCombined: Ubushakashatsi bwimbitse hamwe n’amakuru y’ingenzi hakiri kare (Bing + Google News)
webSearch.providerCombinedDescription: Ikoresha Bing na Google News icyarimwe: amakuru y’ingenzi agaragara mu masegonda make mugihe ubushakashatsi bwa Bing bukomeza, kandi ushobora guhitamo gusubiza uhereye ku makuru yabonetse mbere yo gutegereza ubushakashatsi bwihuta. Bing nikirangira, ibisubizo bibiri birahuzwa.
webSearch.providerBingResponsesDescription: Ikoresha Bing web nk’uko bimeze kuri Bing grounding, ariko bikorwa nka model imwe aho gukoresha Foundry agent — bisanzwe byihuta cyane. Ushobora kugerageza iyi option nshya ugereranyije na Bing grounding.

createDiagrams.title: Kora Amashusho
createDiagrams.prompt: Nyereka uburyo ushobora gukora amashusho n'ibishushanyo by'inzira. Ni ubuhe buryo, inzira z'ibikorwa, cyangwa sisitemu ushobora kumfasha kwerekana? Mpa ingero.

draftContent.title: Andika Ibikubiyemo by'Umwuga
draftContent.prompt: Nkeneye ubufasha bwo kwandika inyandiko z'umwuga - imeri, raporo, incamake. Ushobora kunyereka ingero z'uburyo ushobora gufasha mu bwoko butandukanye bwo kwandika ubucuruzi?

analyzeInformation.title: Sesengura Amakuru
analyzeInformation.prompt: Ushobora kumfasha nte gusesengura amakuru? Nyereka inzira zitandukanye ushobora gukurikiza mu gusesengura imibare, kubona imiterere, cyangwa gukurura ibitekerezo mu nyandiko cyangwa amakuru.

planOrganize.title: Gutegura & Gutunganya
planOrganize.prompt: Ushobora kumfasha gutegura imishinga cyangwa gutunganya akazi? Mpa ingero z'uburyo ushobora gukora inzira z'igihe, gahunda, cyangwa imishinga y'imiterere itandukanye.

brainstormIdeas.title: Gushakisha Ibitekerezo
brainstormIdeas.prompt: Nshaka gushakisha ibisubizo ku kibazo. Nyereka uburyo ugera ku gutekereza bishya no gutanga ibitekerezo - ni ibihe bibazo wakabaza kandi uburyo ushakisha amahirwe?

buildPresentations.title: Kora Iyerekwa
buildPresentations.prompt: Ushobora kumfasha nte gukora iyerekwa? Nyereka ingero z'imiterere itandukanye y'iyerekwa, ibitekerezo by'amashusho, n'uburyo utunganya amakuru ku bantu batandukanye.

workWithCode.title: Gukora na Kode
workWithCode.prompt: Ushobora gufasha mu kwandika kode cyangwa gahunda? Nyereka ingero - yaba ari kwandika kode nshya, gukosora ibibazo, cyangwa gusobanura uburyo ikintu gikora intambwe ku yindi.

decisionSupport.title: Ubufasha mu Gufata Ibyemezo
decisionSupport.prompt: Nkeneye gufata icyemezo ariko sinzi uburyo nsesenguye amahitamo yanjye. Ushobora kunyereka inzira cyangwa uburyo butandukanye ukoresha kugira ngo ufashe gutekereza ku mahitamo?

summarizeSynthesize.title: Gukora Incamake no Guhuza
summarizeSynthesize.prompt: Ufasha ute mu gukora incamake y'inyandiko ndende cyangwa guhuza amakuru aturuka ku nkomoko nyinshi? Nyereka ingero z'imiterere itandukanye y'incamake n'urwego rw'ibisobanuro.

explainTopics.title: Sobanura Insanganyamatsiko Zigoye
explainTopics.prompt: Ushobora gusobanura ibitekerezo bigoye mu magambo yoroshye? Nyereka uburyo ugabanya ibitekerezo bigoye, ukoresha imigereranya, kandi uhindure ibisobanuro ku rwego rw'ubumenyi butandukanye.

createSchedules.title: Kora Gahunda
createSchedules.prompt: Nkeneye ubufasha bwo gutunganya igihe no gukora gahunda. Nyereka inzira zitandukanye ushobora gutunganya gahunda, karendari, cyangwa imishinga ishingiye ku gihe hamwe n'ingero.

gpt_4_1.name: GPT-4.1
gpt_4_1.description: Modeli ya AI ikoreshwa na GPT-4.1 ifite gushakisha ku rubuga mu gihe nyacyo binyuze muri Bing. Itanga amakuru mashya, kugenzura ukuri, n'ubumenyi ku bikorwa bigezweho. Nziza cyane ku bushakashatsi bukeneye amakuru mashya, isesengura ry'amakuru, no kugenzura ukuri.
gpt_4_1.knowledgeCutoff: Gushakisha ku rubuga mu gihe nyacyo

gpt_5_2.name: GPT-5.2
gpt_5_2.description: Modeli ya OpenAI ifite ubushobozi bwinshi cyane, yizewe mu gutekereza bigoye, gukora kode, no gukemura ibibazo by'ikoranabuhanga. Nziza cyane ku mirimo yo gusesengura, ibibazo by'iprogramu, ubushakashatsi, n'ibisobanuro birambuye. Ishyigikira imbaraga zo gutekereza n'ubusobanuro bw'igisubizo bihinduka.

gpt_5_mini.name: GPT-5 Mini
gpt_5_mini.description: Verisiyo yihuse kandi irimo byinshi ya GPT-5, yanonosoye ku muvuduko ikomeje ubwiza bwinshi. Nziza ku mirimo ya buri munsi, ibibazo byihuse, n'iporogaramu zikeneye ibisubizo byihuse. Igereranya neza imikorere n'ubushobozi.

gpt_5_2_chat.name: GPT-5.2 Chat
gpt_5_2_chat.description: Variant idasanzwe ya GPT-5.2 yanozwe kugira ngo ibashe kuganira neza no gusobanukirwa amarangamutima. Irangwa no kumva abandi, kwandika mu buryo bw’ihangano, gutanga ibitekerezo bishya, no kuganira mu buryo busanzwe. Ikwiriye imirimo isaba kumva amarangamutima, ibiganiro bisanzwe, ndetse no gufasha mu nama no kugisha inama.

o3.name: o3
o3.description: Modeli ya OpenAI yo gutekereza ifite ubushobozi bwinshi cyane mu gukemura ibibazo. Yizewe mu mibare igoye, gutekereza mu bumenyi, ibibazo bya kode, n'imirimo y'igenamiterere rya logike. Idirishya ry'umwandiko ry'200K. Ishyigikira kugenzura imbaraga zo gutekereza.

llama_4_maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama_4_maverick.description: Modeli yihuse kandi irimo byinshi iturutse kuri Meta. Nziza ku mirimo ya buri munsi nko kwandika, gukora incamake, n'ubufasha bwa kode y'ibanze. Igereranya neza umuvuduko n'ubwiza ku mirimo isanzwe.

Fungura gushakisha ku rubuga ku butumwa bwose.

Bitanga amakuru mashya ukoresheje Bing mu gihe nyacyo.
dropdown.attachTooltip:
Shyiraho amadosiye, amashusho, cyangwa amajwi/videwo.

Imiterere yemewe:
• Amashusho: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP (5MB ntarengwa, kugeza 10)
• Inyandiko: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, MD (10MB ntarengwa, kugeza 3)
• Amakuru: CSV, JSON, XML, YAML (10MB ntarengwa, kugeza 3)
• Kode: PY, JS, TS, JAVA, C, CPP, GO, nibindi (10MB ntarengwa, kugeza 3)
• Amajwi/Videwo: MP3, WAV, MP4, WebM (25MB ntarengwa, idosiye 1)

Igiteranyo: amadosiye 10, 50MB ntarengwa

Imiterere yemewe: MP3, MP4, WAV, WebM, M4A, MPEG, MPGA
Ingano ntarengwa: 25MB

Kwandika bikora byikora iyo wohereje ubutumwa.

agentAccess.noSourcesAccessible: Nta dosiye ntangiriro ushobora kugeraho z’uyu muyoboro.
agentAccess.partialAccess: Nta burenganzira ufite kuri {denied} muri {total} z’inkomoko z’uyu muyoboro. Ibisubizo ntibizibamo.

agentAccess.partialHint: Fungura idosiye usabe uburenganzira—imuhita iza mu bisubizo nuhabwa uburenganzira.

translate.menuTooltip: Hitamo inyandiko kuri OneDrive cyangwa SharePoint uyihindure—idosiye izanwa ukoresheje uburenganzira bwawe bwa Microsoft 365

docSync.autoPushHint: Impinduka zawe zoherezwa kuri dosiye ihereranye nyuma y’amasegonda make umaze guhagarara kwandika. Impinduka zo hanze ntizisimburwa mu ibanga.
docSync.pushFailed: Ntibishobotse kubika kuri OneDrive—inyandiko yawe ntihindutse hano. Bizageragezwa nongeye guhindura.
docSync.conflictBody: Iyi nyandiko yahindutse kuri OneDrive mugihe wari uri kuyihinduraho. Hitamo ubwoko bugomba kugumaho—nothing izasimburwa utarabihitamo.
docSync.unbindHint: Birahagarika guhuza. Inyandiko isigara hano, iyo kuri OneDrive ntihinduka.
docSync.docxFidelityCaveat: Amadosiye ya Word ahindurirwa ubusanzwe kugirango bihindurwe hano—umutwe, ibikorwa birambuye, nibindi bidasanzwe bishobora koroshywa iyo bibitswe. Ku nyandiko zibuza gushyirwamo ibintu byinshi zisangirwa n’abandi, jya wohereza kopi aho gukoresha sync.
docSync.loadFailed: Ntibishobotse gufungura idosiye kuri OneDrive—gerageza kongera.
docSync.bindingSaved: Byabitswe kuri OneDrive kandi bihujwe ngo bihuzwe.

meetings.menuTooltip: Injiza inyandiko cyangwa amajwi y’inama ya Teams muri ikiganiro—ni iz’inama wayoboye cyangwa witabiriye gusa
meetings.title: Injiza uvuye mu nama
meetings.empty: Nta nama zakozwe kuri internet mu minsi 14 ishize
meetings.checkingAvailability: Turimo kugenzura niba transcript cyangwa recording iboneka…
meetings.importRecordingHint: Recording izashyirwa mu nyandiko nk'igikoresho winjije — ibi bishobora gufata iminota mike ku nama ndende
meetings.recordingAttached: Recording yashyizweho — transcription itangira umaze kohereza
meetings.recordingTooLarge: Recording ini irengeje ubunini ntarengwa bwo kohereza
meetings.nothingAvailable: Nta transcript cyangwa recording iboneka kuri iyi nama
meetings.resolveFailed: Ntibishobotse kugenzura iyi nama — gerageza kongera
meetings.transcriptDenied: Ni abitabiriye gusa bashobora kubona transcript — saba umuyobozi ({organizer}) kuyisangiza
meetings.delegatedNote: Inama zigaragarira kuri kalendari yawe. Transcripts na recordings biboneka gusa ku nama washyizeho cyangwa witabiriye.

errors.consentMissing: Iyi serivisi irindi gutegereza uruhushya rwa admin w'ikigo cyawe.
errors.notConnected: Session yawe ya Microsoft 365 nti iboneka. Gerageza gusohoka no kongera kwinjira.

todo.title: Kora imirimo muri Microsoft To Do
todo.hint: Reba ibyo ugomba gukora hasi aha — gusa ibimeze nk'ibyatoranyijwe ni byo bihinduka imirimo, kuri lisiti yawe ya “AI Assistant” To Do.
todo.noTasksFound: Nta mirimo yabonetse muri iyi nyunganizi.

tools.trayDescription: Kalendari, abantu, imirimo n'ibikoresho bya Teams — bikora nk'uko usanzwe ubikora
tools.alwaysConfirmNote: Ibi bikorwa bisaba guhora byemezwa — ntibishobora kwemerwa byikora.
tools.limitReached: Igihe ntarengwa cy'ibikoresho bya Microsoft 365 cyo ku munsi kirageze — ongera ugerageze ejo.
tools.throttled: Microsoft 365 irabuza ubusabe bwinshi — ongera ugerageze mu munota umwe.

consentCard.replyAllCallout: Gusubiza bose — ubu busubizo bugera kuri bose boherejweho ubutumwa bwa mbere.
consentCard.subject: Umutwe w'ubutumwa

tools.batchToggleHint: Siba ibitari ngombwa — gusa ibyatoranyijwe ni byo bizahabwa.
tools.batchAllUnchecked: Ntakintu cyatoranijwe — kwemera ntacyo byatanga. Hitamo guhakanira ko nta na kimwe ushaka.
tools.connectFirstHint: Huzwa na Microsoft 365 muri Settings → Connections kugirango ukoreshe ibi bikoresho.

playbooks.menuTooltip: Urutonde rw'ibikorwa byinshi bikurikirana kuri kalendari, ubutumwa n'imirimo yawe — bibanza gukusanya amakuru, bigatanga inama, hanyuma bikandika gusa nyuma y'uko wemeye

meetingFollowThrough.title: Gukomeza gukurikirana inama
meetingFollowThrough.description: Incamake, ibikorwa ngombwa, draft y'ibirimo gukorwa no (niba bikenewe) indi nama — byose bituruka kuri iyi transcript

morningTriage.title: Gutoranya ibisabwa mu gitondo
morningTriage.description: Ibyinjiye, ibikigukeneyeho, na kalendari y'uyu munsi — raporo imwe

playbooks.chipsSettingHint: Garagaza inama za playbook hejuru ya message box igihe zibaye zikenewe (nko nyuma yo kwinjiza transcript y’inama).

share.title: Sangira kuri OneDrive
share.introConversation: Bitunganya kopi isomeka y’iki kiganiro muri OneDrive yawe hamwe na link yo kureba ku bantu bo mu kigo cyanyu.
share.introMessage: Bitunganya kopi isomeka y’iki gisubizo muri OneDrive yawe hamwe na link yo kureba ku bantu bo mu kigo cyanyu.
share.recipientsHint: Bireke ubusa kugirango habeho link ireba uwo ari we wese wo mu kigo cyanyu. Ukoresheje imeri, ni abo bantu gusa babona kubona.
share.invalidRecipients: Izi ntabwo zisa nk'aderesi za email: {list}
share.nothingToShare: Nta cyo wasangiza ufite kuri izi filtre.

share.sharedWithPeople: "{name}" biri muri OneDrive yawe kandi bisangiye n’abantu {count} (bareba gusa).
share.consentMissing: Ishyirahamwe ryawe ntiriremera OneDrive kugeza ubu.
share.blockedByPolicy: Gusangiza byabuzanyijwe na politike y’ishyirahamwe ryawe.
share.copyFailed: Ntibyashobotse gukoporora ihuriro — hitamo iri hejuru, unarikopore intoki.
